# agent-signage

> Road signs for coding agents: a PreToolUse hook that checks measurable git facts about the file a coding agent is about to touch and injects one true, actionable line into context only when something is wrong — silent the rest of the time.

Primary CLI:
- `agent-signage install` — writes the Claude Code hook entry
- `agent-signage doctor [path]` — reports what fires here, what stays quiet and why, and the measured cost
- `agent-signage selftest` — asserts the runtime guarantees, no repository needed
- `agent-signage ack <repo> <sign> <token>` — acknowledge one observed state so it stops repeating

Install:
- `pip install agent-signage`, then `agent-signage install` (Claude Code) or wire the printed hook entry into any harness.
- Claude Code plugin, listed in the Hermes Labs marketplace as `agent-signage`:
  `claude plugin marketplace add hermes-labs-ai/agent-signage` then `claude plugin install agent-signage@hermes-labs`.
- From a clone, for one session, nothing installed: `claude --plugin-dir claude-plugin`.
- Any other harness: it is a subprocess that reads tool-call JSON on stdin and writes `additionalContext` JSON or nothing on stdout.

Do not use this repo as:
- a blocking policy or permission gate — every sign is non-blocking, fails open, and never exits non-zero
- a general CI/CD security scanner, or a heuristic/confidence-scored risk signal — every sign reports a measurement, never an inference
- coverage for Bash-invoked edits (`sed -i`, shell scripts), non-git state, or a harness with no `PreToolUse`-equivalent hook wired and trusted
- proof that a published pull request or issue-comment body was authorized — only the separate publisher and Bash gate in `scripts/` own that boundary, and only where actually wired

Maturity: `0.2.x`, early. Six signs, tested over real synthetic git repositories, in production
use at Hermes Labs. The guarantees are asserted by this repository's own test suite, which is a
real bar but not an independent audit; see the README's "Status and limitations" section for
what has and has not been found by outside review.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/agent-signage/blob/main/README.md): the signs, guarantees, cost, configuration, and the separate publication boundary (publisher + Bash gate)
- [docs/design.md](https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/agent-signage/blob/main/docs/design.md): the reasoning behind each guarantee
- [docs/integrating.md](https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/agent-signage/blob/main/docs/integrating.md): wiring this into a harness permanently
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/agent-signage/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): the bar a new sign has to meet (sound, silent, actionable)
- [CITATION.cff](https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/agent-signage/blob/main/CITATION.cff): how to cite this software

Hermes Labs is an agentic infrastructure company building the reliability layer for autonomous systems.
